text: We built ArcVault to turn incoming support messages into clear next steps. This walkthrough uses an AI-generated voice. We’ll send a request through our webhook, then review the five assessment scenarios using real model results.

We choose the source, paste the original message, and send it. We save the request first, then our worker asks Terra to classify it, extract useful details, and write a summary. We use Python rules to decide the final destination.

For the Okta question, we use the model’s technical-question classification and medium priority to route it to Technical Support. We keep the summary brief, and we preserve the customer’s exact wording as evidence for the extracted integration.

For the dashboard outage, we detect that multiple users are affected. Our policy sends it to Human Review, while retaining Engineering as the standard destination. We make the reason visible immediately. We can also inspect the supporting signals and export the complete saved result as JSON.
